outcome: An owner can inspect which tests prove each delivery criterion, identify omitted tiers, and see that human acceptance is still pending.
constraints: Use the existing pinned kernel, pack release hashes, and command-review receipts.
Do not execute product test commands during plan or receipt checking.
Never infer human approval from test success or authenticate a typed reviewer name.
Keep game-design product code and its existing sources of truth unchanged.

acceptance.description: A plan with missing criteria, dangling references, escaping paths, or unaddressed test tiers fails.
The pinned pack composes into a real fixture consumer, runs repeatedly, fails on injected damage, and passes after revert.
A planned report cannot claim verified evidence, human acceptance, or merge authorization.

tier_waivers.reason: This pilot checks the checker and real CLI/pack composition together; receipt semantics have additional module-seam coverage in test/delivery-evidence.test.mjs.
The fixture exercises a local hashed pack and source CLI, not a remotely published release or a graphical application. Shipping-product and game acceptance remain outside this pilot.
